newsitem.title: USA: United Leisure plans Las Vegas casino.
newsitem.headline: United Leisure plans Las Vegas casino.

text.p: United Leisure Corp said Wednesday that it signed an agreement to buy a 50 percent interest in about 8.5 acres of partially developed land in the heart of the Strip in Las Vegas, Nevada, for a purchase price of $24 million in cash and notes.

The company plans to develop the property into a major theme center including a casino, hotel, mall and theme restaurants through a 50 percent owned subsidiary. Currently on the property is the Silver City Casino as well as several retailers. The Silver City Casino is managed by Circus Circus which will continue to manage the casino operation. The property is located directly across from Circus Circus and the Stardust Hotel, adjacent to the Riviera Hotel and only a short distance from the Las Vegas convention center.

The transaction is expected to close upon the settlement of pending legal action against the current lender. The lender on the existing trust deed has refused to approve the assignment of the loan. United Leisure and the seller of the property will bring a legal action to force the lender to accept the assignment since, in the opinion of company's counsel, the loan is assignable. At the same time, the company is seeking to refinance the property.
